title: A Functional Central Limit Theorem for Window Counts of Hardy--Szegő Zeros
summary: The Hardy--Szegő zero process, investigated in the disk by Peres and Virág through the independent identically distributed Gaussian analytic function, is a canonical conformally invariant determinantal point process. This paper studies its upper half-plane realization. Although conformally equivalent to the disk model, this realization has its own natural geometry: real-translation invariance turns the process into a stationary object along the boundary and makes long horizontal windows the natural observables.
